notes.title: Release ver. 1.0.5 balancing and QoL
notes.notes:
new

 added the ability to sort by value in the Your Aquarium menu


 added the ability to drag and drop around the fish cards in Your Aquarium menu using right click


 added auto-equip of a newly bought item


 added a new Setting to set the main screen in multi-monitor setups



balances

 reduced chance of A and S tier fish early on


 fishing time now is slightly slower (a new set of items is in the works that will affect this variable)


 mid and late game fish now can go more time without food



upcoming updates

 new set of items

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.4
notes.notes:
fixes

- fixed the description of in-game Clown Fiesta and Tunak Tunak Tuna achievements.
- fixed Steam's Missing Achievements
- fixed Dark Bramble achievement not progressing
- fixed Size Matters Upgrade lvl 13 costing 50k when it should be 500k

to report any bugs, feel free to visit the discord available in the steam page
stay tuned for more stuff soon <3

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3 - 0.4 - 0.5 (Achievements, Save System, and +)
notes.notes:
Over the last couple of weeks I've been uploading the demo and here's all that's new since the 0.2 patch notes:



demo ver. 0.3.0 save system 

new 

added a save button in the settings menu,

game auto saves every 2 minutes


demo ver. 0.4.0 achievements

new 

Achievements tab in the Collection Menu,

Fish now react with hearts when fed,

Character customization button in the Main Menu,

 balance 

The Crystal Clear Upgrade rewards with more Jar space than before,

 known issues 

the Character customization doesn't save the character between different play sessions


demo ver. 0.5.0 QoL improvements

new

added more feedback when feeding fish.

added button to change the game window (top of screen or bottom), and option to change the offset in settings

added pin button to the Your Aquarium fish cards so that you can favorite fish and avoid selling them by mistake

added (finally) the fish state of each fish (their food and coin production progress) to the save system 

added a Credits tab in the Settings Menu

fixes

fixed fish over eating when multiple food pieces are nearby

notes.title: Demo Update 0.2 (Upgrades!)
notes.notes:
I've uploaded some minor fixes throughout the weeks but they were very small to warrant a full patch note, but this new update does deserve a highlight hehe



new

 added Upgrades to the game! Check them out in the Shop Menu

 added the coins generated per minute to the Suizopedia and Your Aquarium fish.



fixes

fixed bug where menus would stack on top of each others.

 fixed visual error where the text inside buttons would clip.

 disabled the purchase of items in the Items Tab until their properties are fixed.

 fixed error where certain values would be shown rounded down, for example 7.5k would be shown as 7k. Now it is shown as 7.5k.

 adjusted volume levels to be lower by default



known bugs

 fish go out of bounds and never come back (it's not personal, they just be doing that, I'm working on fixing it)

when using two monitors with different resolution, game gets stuck in the middle of both.



upcoming updates

steam and in-game achievements!

save system



as always thank you <3<3<3 for all the feedback and feel free to join the discord if you haven't yet!

ALSOO, the kickstarter is ending this very week, so if you want unique perks make sure to check it out right now! 👇
